blind.B1: No. Mouse soleus, 10 CONTROL (pair-fed, sham-irradiated) vs 10 SPACE (14-day hindlimb unloading + 1 Gy X-ray + corticosterone) (S2.3.p1, S2.4.p1, S2.5.p1). Disuse/atrophy model; no sample carries an exercise factor. Exercise is background only.
blind.B2: SPACE vs CONTROL, n=10 vs 10 male C57BL/6J mice, one soleus each (S2.3.p1); coding genes (S3.1.p1) and lncRNAs (S3.2.p1).
blind.B3: No repeated measures: one soleus per mouse, 20 mice. Packet key 'title without grp level' is just the Sample 1..10 numbering (expression check not_supported, p=0.35). Pair-feeding matches food intake only (S2.3.p3), not a sample pairing.
blind.B4: Paper does not say joint or pairwise; only two groups exist, so moot (edgeR, S2.6.p3).
blind.B5: Coding genes: 'FDR < 0.01' with 3525 down / 2666 up = 6191 (S3.1.p1); methods S2.6.p3 'FDR < 0.01, FC ± 1' (for the DAVID/ORA gene set). lncRNAs: 'P < 0.01' in S3.2.p1 (FIG2 legend: -log10FDR > 2), 465 lncRNAs.

checks.evidence: S2.3.p1-S2.5.p1: no exercise arm; refusal matches B1. The 'Hind-limb unloading' exercise-word flag is a disuse value, not exercise.
CONTROL 10 / SPACE 10 matches S2.3.p1; grp from title agrees with characteristics treatment columns; no exclusions.
One soleus per mouse; title-number key not supported by expression (not_supported, p=0.35) and is only a label index.
HANDBACK notes radiation and corticosterone aliased with unloading; single sex, no batch info.
Integer featureCounts, 56941 x 20; edgeR recorded as paper method.
FDR<0.01 recorded with no FC cutoff (S3.1.p1); methods S2.6.p3 also says 'FC ± 1' for the ORA gene set, not recorded in paper_threshold. Not used since case refused.
checks.fix: Optionally note the 'FC ± 1' wording from S2.6.p3 in the discrepancies list.

checks.evidence: No numbers compared; HANDBACK claims none.
'No exercise arm' is true: both arms and the methods were checked; the only exercise mention is S1.p4 background.

human_items: Open policy: whether a disuse (unloading) model should be offered as an inverse-exercise contrast; the case correctly declines under current rules.
summary: 该系列是太空模拟（后肢悬吊+辐射+皮质酮）对照小鼠比目鱼肌，没有运动组，拒绝运行的理由成立。分组、基质与方法记录均与论文一致，无重复测量。仅阈值处有一处次要措辞（方法中的 FC ± 1）可补记。
